## read data

```{r}
read_lps_data <- function (file) {
  counts <- fread(file)
  class(counts) <- "data.frame"
  genes <- counts[,1]
  counts <- t(as.matrix(counts[,-1]))
  colnames(counts) <- genes
  samples <- rownames(counts)
  samples <- strsplit(samples,"_")
  samples <- data.frame(tissue    = sapply(samples,"[[",1),
                        timepoint = sapply(samples,"[[",2),
                        mouse     = sapply(samples,"[[",3))
  samples <- transform(samples,
                       tissue    = factor(tissue),
					   timepoint = factor(timepoint),
					   mouse     = factor(mouse))
  return(list(samples = samples,counts = counts))
}
out <- read_lps_data("../data/lps.csv.gz")
samples <- out$samples
counts  <- out$counts
rm(out)
```


Remove a sample that appears to be an outlier based on the NMF analyses:

```{r filter-outliers}
i       <- which(rownames(counts) != "iLN_d2_20")
samples <- samples[i,]
counts  <- counts[i,]
```

Remove genes that are expressed in fewer than 5 samples:

```{r filter-genes}
j <- which(colSums(counts > 0) > 4)
counts <- counts[,j]
```

This is the dimension of the data set we will analyze:

```{r dim-counts}
dim(counts)
```



```{r}
set.seed(1)
tm <- fit_poisson_nmf(counts,k = 14,init.method = "random",method = "em",
                      numiter = 20,verbose = "none",
					  control = list(numiter = 4,nc = 8,extrapolate = FALSE))
tm <- fit_poisson_nmf(counts,fit0 = tm,method = "scd",numiter = 40,
                      control = list(numiter = 4,nc = 8,extrapolate = TRUE),
					  verbose = "none")
tm_mn <- poisson2multinom(tm)
L     <- tm_mn$L               # samples × topics matrix

```


```{r}
library(limma)
library(matrixStats)

# L: N x K  (samples x topics)
stopifnot(nrow(L) == nrow(samples))

# timepoint factor with d0 as reference
tp <- factor(
  as.character(samples$timepoint),
  levels = c("d0","d0.25","d0.5","d1","d2","d3","d5")
)
tp <- relevel(tp, ref = "d0")

keep <- !is.na(tp)
samples_sub <- droplevels(samples[keep, , drop = FALSE])
L_sub <- L[keep, , drop = FALSE]
tp <- droplevels(tp[keep])

# ---- topic-specific epsilon eps_k = c0 * median(L_sub[,k]) ----
c0 <- 1e-4
med_k <- colMedians(L_sub, na.rm = TRUE)
eps_k <- c0 * med_k

# guardrails
eps_min <- 1e-12
eps_max <- 1e-2
eps_k <- pmin(pmax(eps_k, eps_min), eps_max)

# optional numerical clamp
L01 <- pmin(pmax(L_sub, 0), 1)

# log-odds transform: Z_{ik} = log((theta+eps_k)/(1-theta+eps_k))
num <- sweep(L01, 2, eps_k, FUN = "+")
den <- sweep(1 - L01, 2, eps_k, FUN = "+")
Z <- log(num / den)   # N x K

# limma expects features x samples => K x N
Y <- t(Z)
rownames(Y) <- paste0("T", seq_len(ncol(L_sub)))
```


## Model: (logit) compare all timepoints (tp + tissue)

```{r}
design <- model.matrix(~ tp + tissue, data = samples_sub)
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))
fit <- lmFit(Y, design)
fit <- eBayes(fit)


tp_coefs <- grep("^tp", colnames(design), value = TRUE)

res_list <- lapply(tp_coefs, function(cf) {
  tt <- topTable(fit, coef = cf, number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
  tt$coef <- cf
  tt$topic <- rownames(tt)
  tt
})

res_all <- do.call(rbind, res_list)
res_all
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

# 1) Build matrix: rows=topic, cols=coef, values=-log10(adj.P.Val)
mat_df <- res_all %>%
  mutate(neglog10FDR = -log10(adj.P.Val + 1e-300)) %>%  # avoid log(0)
  select(topic, coef, neglog10FDR) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = coef, values_from = neglog10FDR)

mat_m <- as.matrix(mat_df[,-1])
rownames(mat_m) <- mat_df$topic

# (optional) order columns chronologically
col_order <- c("tpd0.25","tpd0.5","tpd1","tpd2","tpd3","tpd5")
col_order <- intersect(col_order, colnames(mat_m))
mat_m <- mat_m[, col_order, drop = FALSE]

# 2) Color mapping
mx <- max(mat_m, na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(0, 1.301, mx), c("white", "#fdbb84", "#e34a33"))
# 1.301 = -log10(0.05)

Heatmap(
  mat_m,
  name = "-log10(FDR)",           # must be character
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  na_col = "grey95",
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "-log10(BH FDR)",
    at = c(0, 1.301, round(mx,1)),
    labels = c("1", "0.05", paste0("max=", round(mx,1)))
  )
)

```
```{r}
dir_df <- res_all %>%
  mutate(code = ifelse(adj.P.Val < 0.05, sign(logFC), 0)) %>%
  select(topic, coef, code) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = coef, values_from = code)

dir_m <- as.matrix(dir_df[,-1])
rownames(dir_m) <- dir_df$topic

Heatmap(
  dir_m,
  name = "Dir (FDR<0.05)",
  col = c("-1"="blue", "0"="white", "1"="red"),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE
)
```
```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

thr <- 1.301  # -log10(0.05)

Heatmap(
  mat_m,
  name = "-log10(FDR)",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  na_col = "grey95",
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "-log10(BH FDR)",
    at = c(0, thr, round(mx,1)),
    labels = c("1", "0.05", paste0("max=", round(mx,1)))
  ),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (!is.na(mat_m[i, j]) && mat_m[i, j] > thr) {
      grid.text("✪", x, y, gp = gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 10))
    }
  }
)

```

```{r}
thr <- 1.301  # -log10(0.05)

# cap values at significance threshold
mat_cap <- pmin(mat_m, thr)

col_fun_sig <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, thr),
  c("white", "#d7301f")   # red for significant
)

Heatmap(
  mat_cap,
  name = "-log10(FDR)",
  col = col_fun_sig,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  na_col = "grey95",
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "-log10(BH FDR)",
    at = c(0, thr),
    labels = c("NS", "< 0.05")
  ),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (!is.na(mat_m[i, j]) && mat_m[i, j] > thr) {
      grid.text("✪", x, y,
                gp = gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"))
    }
  }
)
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

alpha <- 0.05

# 1) build matrices: effect (e.g. logFC) and FDR
eff_df <- res_all %>%
  select(topic, coef, logFC) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = coef, values_from = logFC)

fdr_df <- res_all %>%
  select(topic, coef, adj.P.Val) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = coef, values_from = adj.P.Val)

eff_m <- as.matrix(eff_df[,-1]); rownames(eff_m) <- eff_df$topic
fdr_m <- as.matrix(fdr_df[,-1]); rownames(fdr_m) <- fdr_df$topic

# 2) choose a symmetric range for colors (robust to outliers)
rng <- quantile(abs(eff_m), 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)  # or max(abs(eff_m), na.rm=TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-rng, 0, rng), c("#2c7bb6", "white", "#d7191c"))

# 3) draw heatmap: color by logFC, mark significant cells
Heatmap(
  eff_m,
  name = "logFC",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  na_col = "grey95",
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (!is.na(fdr_m[i, j]) && fdr_m[i, j] < alpha) {
      # # option A: star
      # grid.text("★", x, y, gp = gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"))

      # option B (alternative): draw a bold border instead of star
      grid.rect(x, y, width, height, gp = gpar(fill = NA, col = "black", lwd = 2))
    }
  }
)
```
### plot beta through time

```{r}
library(scales)

alpha <- 0.05
coef_to_time <- function(cf) sub("^tpd", "d", cf)

plot_df <- res_all %>%
  mutate(
    time = coef_to_time(coef),
    time = factor(time, levels = c("d0.25","d0.5","d1","d2","d3","d5")),
    sig  = adj.P.Val < alpha
  ) %>%
  arrange(topic, time)


cap <- quantile(abs(plot_df$logFC), 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = time, y = logFC, group = topic)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(color = logFC, alpha = sig), size = 2) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 0.2, `TRUE` = 1), guide = "none") +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    midpoint = 0,
    low  = "#2166AC",   # stronger blue
    mid  = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",   # stronger red
    limits = c(-cap, cap),
    oob = squish,
    name = "logFC\n(signed)"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ topic, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Time effects (logFC) relative to d0 for all topics",
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "logFC (log-odds change vs d0)"
  )
```

## Model: remove cell state (logit)

```{r}
library(limma)

# --- same as before: build tp, keep, Z, Y ---

tp <- factor(as.character(samples$timepoint),
             levels = c("d0","d0.25","d0.5","d1","d2","d3","d5"))
tp <- relevel(tp, ref = "d0")

keep <- !is.na(tp)
samples_sub <- droplevels(samples[keep, , drop = FALSE])
L_sub <- L[keep, , drop = FALSE]
tp <- droplevels(tp[keep])

eps <- 1e-8
Z <- log((L_sub + eps) / (1 - L_sub + eps))   # N x K
Y <- t(Z)                                     # K x N
rownames(Y) <- paste0("T", seq_len(ncol(L_sub)))

# ----------------------------
# ✅ design WITHOUT tissue
# ----------------------------
design <- model.matrix(~ tp, data = samples_sub)
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))

fit <- eBayes(lmFit(Y, design))

# # example: d3 vs d0
# res_d3 <- topTable(fit, coef = "tpd3", number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
# head(res_d3)

# all timepoints vs d0
tp_coefs <- grep("^tp", colnames(design), value = TRUE)

res_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tp_coefs, function(cf) {
  tt <- topTable(fit, coef = cf, number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
  tt$coef  <- cf
  tt$topic <- rownames(tt)
  tt
}))

res_all
```

```{r}
alpha <- 0.05

# convert "tpd3" -> "d3"
coef_to_time <- function(cf) sub("^tpd", "d", cf)

plot_df <- res_all %>%
  mutate(
    time = coef_to_time(coef),
    time = factor(time, levels = c("d0.25","d0.5","d1","d2","d3","d5")),
    sig  = adj.P.Val < alpha
  ) %>%
  arrange(topic, time)

cap <- quantile(abs(plot_df$logFC), 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = time, y = logFC, group = topic)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_line(color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(color = logFC, alpha = sig), size = 2) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 0.2, `TRUE` = 1), guide = "none") +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    midpoint = 0,
    low  = "#2166AC",
    mid  = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    limits = c(-cap, cap),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "logFC\n(signed)"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ topic, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Time effects (logFC) relative to d0 for all topics (no tissue adjustment)",
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "logFC (log-odds change vs d0)"
  )

```

```{r}
# prediction grid: all timepoints
newdat <- data.frame(tp = factor(levels(tp), levels = levels(tp)))
Xnew <- model.matrix(~ tp, data = newdat)
colnames(Xnew) <- make.names(colnames(Xnew))

topics <- rownames(fit$coefficients)

pred_df <- bind_rows(lapply(topics, function(k) {
  b <- fit$coefficients[k, colnames(Xnew)]  # align
  zhat <- as.numeric(Xnew %*% b)
  tibble(
    topic = k,
    tp = newdat$tp,
    pred_logit = zhat,
    pred_theta = plogis(zhat)   # back-transform to proportion
  )
}))


alpha <- 0.05

# tp coefficients in the fitted model (e.g. "tpd0.25", "tpd3", ...)
tp_coefs <- grep("^tp", colnames(design), value = TRUE)

# Extract p-values + BH per coef across topics
sig_long <- bind_rows(lapply(tp_coefs, function(cf) {
  tt <- topTable(fit, coef = cf, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
  tibble(
    topic = rownames(tt),
    coef  = cf,
    P.Value = tt$P.Value,
    adj.P.Val = tt$adj.P.Val,
    sig = tt$adj.P.Val < alpha
  )
}))

# Map coef name -> timepoint label used in pred_df ("d3", "d0.25", ...)
coef_to_tp <- function(cf) sub("^tp", "", cf)

sig_long <- sig_long %>%
  mutate(tp = coef_to_tp(coef))

sig_long <- bind_rows(
  sig_long,
  expand.grid(topic = unique(sig_long$topic), tp = "d0") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(P.Value = NA_real_, adj.P.Val = NA_real_, sig = FALSE)
)
pred_df2 <- pred_df %>%
  mutate(tp = as.character(tp)) %>%
  left_join(sig_long %>% select(topic, tp, sig), by = c("topic","tp")) %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(is.na(sig), FALSE, sig))

```

```{r}
ggplot(pred_df2, aes(x = tp, y = pred_theta, group = 1)) +
  # line: fixed color, no significance mapping
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  # points: colored by significance
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 2.2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ topic, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = "grey70", `TRUE` = "red"),
    name = paste0("BH < ", alpha)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Fitted topic proportion",
    title = "Limma-fitted topic proportions"
  )

```
